steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Every statistical investigation has constraints that limit what is possible. | Key Fact: Time constraints affect how long you can spend collecting and analysing data. | Key Fact: Cost constraints limit the resources available — equipment, travel, printing, software. | Key Fact: Ethical issues include obtaining consent, avoiding harm, and being honest about results.
